children: American depositary receipts of Endava declined after the technology company placed its finance chief on administrative leave during an investigation into Endava's accounting practices.
ADRs slid 14% to $2.39 in premarket trading Tuesday. As of Monday's market close, ADRs are down 56% year to date.

Endava said its board placed Chief Financial Officer Mark Thurston on leave after a recommendation from its audit committee. The leave is pending the conclusion of an investigation by independent counsel based on concerns over accounting treatment of certain customers and supplier agreements, the company said.
Thurston is being succeeded by Conor McShane of the consulting firm AlixPartners, who will serve in the interim.
Thurston joined the company in 2015 and is also on the board, according to Endava's website.
